landing.meta_title: Dexys Klip: turn long videos into vertical clips
landing.meta_description: Paste a link or upload a video. Dexys Klip finds the best moments, reframes them to vertical with face tracking and adds animated captions for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. Processed in the EU.
landing.hero_eyebrow: For podcasts, streams, talks and gameplay
landing.hero_title: Long videos in. Short clips out.
landing.hero_lead: Dexys Klip finds the best moments in your video, reframes them to vertical with face tracking and adds animated captions, ready for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. You decide what to keep.
landing.hero_note: Free plan: 30 minutes of video a month. No card needed.
landing.hero_figure: Illustration: a wide podcast video with three highlighted moments on its timeline. One moment becomes a vertical clip that follows the speaker’s face, with word-by-word captions and a virality score of 92.
landing.how_title: From one long video to clips you can post
landing.how_lead: Three steps. The slow parts happen while you do something else.
landing.step1_b: Paste a link or upload a file. Pick a clip length, how many clips and a caption style, or keep the defaults.
landing.step2_b: It transcribes the video, picks the strongest moments and scores each one, with the reasons. Titles, descriptions and hashtags are written for you.
landing.step3_b: Trim, change the captions or the framing, choose 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9, and export. Editing and exporting again uses no extra minutes.
landing.features_lead: The tedious parts of making shorts, done for you, and still yours to change.
landing.show_title: See why each moment made the cut
landing.show_body: Every clip gets a virality score with the reasons behind it: how strong the hook is, whether there’s a payoff, whether it makes sense on its own, and the pace. Use it to decide what to post first.
landing.score_figure: Example score breakdown for one clip: virality score 92, with hook 95, payoff 90, standalone 88 and pace 84.
landing.mock_hook: “Nobody tells you this about your first year.”
landing.f_reframe_b: Klip follows the speaker from shot to shot. For screen recordings, use a blurred background or set the crop yourself.
landing.f_captions_b: Word-by-word captions in several styles, with emphasized keywords. Fix a word in the transcript and the captions follow.
landing.f_copy_b: Every clip comes with post text you can edit, then copy in one click.
landing.f_editor_b: Trim on the transcript, switch caption style and reframing, pick 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9, then export.
landing.f_brand_b: Save your logo, fonts and caption colours once. They’re applied to every new clip.
landing.f_teams_b: Work together in a shared workspace. Admins manage billing and data; members make clips.
landing.privacy_title: Your videos stay in the EU
landing.privacy_lead: For creators and teams who care where their content goes.
landing.p1_b: Videos, transcripts, clips and payments are stored and processed in the European Union. Payments are handled by Mollie in the Netherlands.
landing.p2_b: Your videos and transcripts are used only to make your clips. They are not used to train AI models.
landing.p3_b: Download a copy of everything in your workspace, or delete it, from the Data and privacy page.
landing.privacy_note: Sign-in is provided by Clerk, from the United States.
landing.pricing_lead: Start free. Upgrade when you need more minutes, longer videos or no watermark.
landing.a_minutes: By the length of each video you add, once. Finding clips again, editing and exporting don’t use more minutes. Your minutes reset every month.
landing.a_free: Yes. Free includes 30 minutes of video a month, videos up to 20 minutes long, 720p exports and a watermark. No card needed.
landing.a_langs: Videos are transcribed in 15 languages, including English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German and Dutch. Klip detects the language, or you choose it. The app itself is in English, Brazilian Portuguese and Dutch.
landing.q_training: Do you train AI on my videos?
landing.a_training: No. Your content is used only to make your clips, and our AI providers don’t use it for training either.
landing.a_data: In the EU: videos, transcripts, clips and payments. Sign-in runs on Clerk in the United States, under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework.
landing.a_cancel: Yes. Paid plans renew monthly until you cancel from the billing page. You keep your plan until the end of the month you paid for.
landing.a_rights: You do. You keep all rights to your videos and to the clips you make.
landing.cta_body: Add a video and see what Klip finds. The free plan needs no card.
landing.footer_tagline: Short vertical clips from long videos. Made by Dexys Works.

pricing.title: Plans
pricing.lead: Minutes are counted once per uploaded video. Re-editing and re-exporting clips is free.
pricing.thanks: Thanks. Your plan updates within a few seconds.
pricing.tag_free: Try it with your own videos.
pricing.tag_pro: For creators who publish every week.
pricing.tag_business: For teams that publish every day.
pricing.notConfigured: Online checkout isn’t configured on this server.
pricing.vatNote: Prices include VAT. Your exact price, based on your country and VAT number, is shown before you pay.

landing.meta_title: Dexys Klip: transforme vídeos longos em clipes verticais
landing.meta_description: Cole um link ou envie um vídeo. O Dexys Klip encontra os melhores momentos, reenquadra para vertical com rastreamento de rosto e adiciona legendas animadas para TikTok, Reels e Shorts. Processado na UE.
landing.hero_eyebrow: Para podcasts, lives, palestras e gameplay
landing.hero_title: Vídeo longo entra. Clipes curtos saem.
landing.hero_lead: O Dexys Klip encontra os melhores momentos do seu vídeo, reenquadra para vertical com rastreamento de rosto e adiciona legendas animadas, prontos para TikTok, Reels e Shorts. Você decide o que fica.
landing.hero_note: Plano grátis: 30 minutos de vídeo por mês. Sem cartão.
landing.hero_figure: Ilustração: um vídeo de podcast horizontal com três momentos destacados na linha do tempo. Um deles vira um clipe vertical que acompanha o rosto de quem fala, com legendas palavra por palavra e pontuação de viralidade 92.
landing.sources_upload: ou envie um arquivo de vídeo
landing.how_title: De um vídeo longo a clipes prontos para postar
landing.how_lead: Três passos. A parte demorada acontece enquanto você faz outra coisa.
landing.step1_b: Cole um link ou envie um arquivo. Escolha a duração, quantos clipes e o estilo de legenda, ou deixe o padrão.
landing.step2_b: Ele transcreve o vídeo, escolhe os momentos mais fortes e dá uma pontuação a cada um, com os motivos. Títulos, descrições e hashtags já vêm prontos.
landing.step3_b: Corte, mude as legendas ou o enquadramento, escolha 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 ou 16:9 e exporte. Editar e exportar de novo não gasta minutos extras.
landing.features_title: Tudo o que um clipe precisa
landing.features_lead: A parte chata de fazer vídeos curtos, feita para você, e você ainda pode mudar tudo.
landing.show_title: Veja por que cada momento foi escolhido
landing.show_body: Cada clipe recebe uma pontuação de viralidade com os motivos: a força do gancho, se há um desfecho, se faz sentido sozinho e o ritmo. Use isso para decidir o que postar primeiro.
landing.score_figure: Exemplo de pontuação de um clipe: viralidade 92, com gancho 95, desfecho 90, autonomia 88 e ritmo 84.
landing.mock_hook: “Ninguém te conta isso sobre o seu primeiro ano.”
landing.f_reframe_b: O Klip acompanha quem fala a cada cena. Para gravações de tela, use fundo desfocado ou defina o corte você mesmo.
landing.f_captions_b: Legendas palavra por palavra em vários estilos, com palavras-chave em destaque. Corrija uma palavra na transcrição e a legenda acompanha.
landing.f_copy_b: Cada clipe vem com o texto do post, que você pode editar e copiar com um clique.
landing.f_editor_b: Corte pela transcrição, troque o estilo de legenda e o enquadramento, escolha 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 ou 16:9 e exporte.
landing.f_brand_b: Salve seu logo, fontes e cores de legenda uma vez. Eles são aplicados a cada novo clipe.
landing.f_teams_b: Trabalhe junto em um espaço compartilhado. Admins cuidam da cobrança e dos dados; membros fazem clipes.
landing.privacy_lead: Para criadores e equipes que se importam com o destino do seu conteúdo.
landing.p1_b: Vídeos, transcrições, clipes e pagamentos são armazenados e processados na União Europeia. Os pagamentos são feitos pela Mollie, na Holanda.
landing.p2_b: Seus vídeos e transcrições são usados só para fazer seus clipes. Eles não são usados para treinar modelos de IA.
landing.p3_b: Baixe uma cópia de tudo no seu espaço, ou apague tudo, na página Dados e privacidade.
landing.privacy_note: O login é fornecido pela Clerk, a partir dos Estados Unidos.
landing.pricing_lead: Comece grátis. Mude de plano quando precisar de mais minutos, vídeos mais longos ou sem marca d’água.
landing.a_minutes: Pela duração de cada vídeo adicionado, uma vez só. Buscar clipes de novo, editar e exportar não gastam mais minutos. Os minutos renovam todo mês.
landing.a_free: Sim. O Grátis inclui 30 minutos de vídeo por mês, vídeos de até 20 minutos, exportação em 720p e marca d’água. Sem cartão.
landing.a_langs: Os vídeos são transcritos em 15 idiomas, incluindo português, inglês, espanhol, francês, alemão e holandês. O Klip detecta o idioma, ou você escolhe. O app está em inglês, português do Brasil e holandês.
landing.q_training: Vocês treinam IA com meus vídeos?
landing.a_training: Não. Seu conteúdo é usado só para fazer seus clipes, e nossos fornecedores de IA também não o usam para treinamento.
landing.a_data: Na UE: vídeos, transcrições, clipes e pagamentos. O login usa a Clerk, nos Estados Unidos, sob o EU–US Data Privacy Framework.
landing.a_cancel: Sim. Os planos pagos renovam todo mês até você cancelar na página de cobrança. Você mantém o plano até o fim do mês já pago.
landing.a_rights: Seus. Você mantém todos os direitos sobre seus vídeos e os clipes que fizer.
landing.cta_body: Adicione um vídeo e veja o que o Klip encontra. O plano grátis não pede cartão.
landing.footer_tagline: Clipes verticais curtos a partir de vídeos longos. Feito pela Dexys Works.

pricing.title: Planos
pricing.lead: Os minutos são contados uma vez por vídeo enviado. Reeditar e reexportar cortes é grátis.
pricing.thanks: Obrigado. Seu plano é atualizado em alguns segundos.
pricing.tag_pro: Para criadores que publicam toda semana.
pricing.tag_business: Para equipes que publicam todo dia.
pricing.notConfigured: O pagamento online não está configurado neste servidor.
pricing.vatNote: Os preços incluem IVA. O preço exato, conforme seu país e número de IVA, aparece antes do pagamento.

landing.meta_title: Dexys Klip: maak van lange video’s verticale clips
landing.meta_description: Plak een link of upload een video. Dexys Klip vindt de beste momenten, maakt ze verticaal met gezichtsvolging en voegt geanimeerde ondertitels toe voor TikTok, Reels en Shorts. Verwerkt in de EU.
landing.hero_eyebrow: Voor podcasts, streams, presentaties en gameplay
landing.hero_title: Lange video erin. Korte clips eruit.
landing.hero_lead: Dexys Klip vindt de beste momenten in je video, maakt ze verticaal met gezichtsvolging en voegt geanimeerde ondertitels toe, klaar voor TikTok, Reels en Shorts. Jij bepaalt wat je houdt.
landing.hero_note: Gratis abonnement: 30 minuten video per maand. Geen creditcard nodig.
landing.hero_figure: Illustratie: een brede podcastvideo met drie gemarkeerde momenten op de tijdlijn. Eén moment wordt een verticale clip die het gezicht van de spreker volgt, met ondertitels per woord en een viraliteitsscore van 92.
landing.how_title: Van één lange video naar clips die je kunt posten
landing.how_lead: Drie stappen. Het trage werk gebeurt terwijl jij iets anders doet.
landing.step1_b: Plak een link of upload een bestand. Kies de cliplengte, het aantal clips en een ondertitelstijl, of houd de standaard.
landing.step2_b: Het transcribeert de video, kiest de sterkste momenten en geeft elk een score, met de redenen. Titels, beschrijvingen en hashtags worden voor je geschreven.
landing.step3_b: Knip bij, wijzig de ondertitels of de uitsnede, kies 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 of 16:9 en exporteer. Opnieuw bewerken en exporteren kost geen extra minuten.
landing.features_title: Alles wat een clip nodig heeft
landing.features_lead: Het saaie werk van shorts maken, voor je gedaan, en nog steeds door jou aan te passen.
landing.show_title: Zie waarom elk moment is gekozen
landing.show_body: Elke clip krijgt een viraliteitsscore met de redenen erachter: hoe sterk de hook is, of er een payoff is, of hij op zichzelf te begrijpen is, en het tempo. Zo kies je wat je eerst post.
landing.score_figure: Voorbeeld van de score van één clip: viraliteit 92, met hook 95, payoff 90, zelfstandig 88 en tempo 84.
landing.mock_hook: “Niemand vertelt je dit over je eerste jaar.”
landing.f_reframe_b: Klip volgt de spreker van shot naar shot. Voor schermopnames kies je een vervaagde achtergrond of bepaal je zelf de uitsnede.
landing.f_captions_b: Ondertitels per woord in meerdere stijlen, met benadrukte trefwoorden. Verbeter een woord in het transcript en de ondertitels volgen.
landing.f_copy_b: Elke clip krijgt posttekst die je kunt aanpassen en met één klik kopieert.
landing.f_editor_b: Knip in het transcript, wissel van ondertitelstijl en uitsnede, kies 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 of 16:9 en exporteer.
landing.f_brand_b: Sla je logo, lettertypes en ondertitelkleuren één keer op. Ze worden op elke nieuwe clip toegepast.
landing.f_teams_b: Werk samen in een gedeelde werkruimte. Beheerders regelen facturatie en data; leden maken clips.
landing.privacy_title: Je video’s blijven in de EU
landing.privacy_lead: Voor makers en teams die willen weten waar hun content naartoe gaat.
landing.p1_b: Video’s, transcripten, clips en betalingen worden opgeslagen en verwerkt in de Europese Unie. Betalingen lopen via Mollie in Nederland.
landing.p2_b: Je video’s en transcripten worden alleen gebruikt om je clips te maken. Ze worden niet gebruikt om AI-modellen te trainen.
landing.p3_t: Exporteer of verwijder wanneer je wilt
landing.p3_b: Download een kopie van alles in je werkruimte, of verwijder het, via de pagina Data en privacy.
landing.privacy_note: Inloggen verloopt via Clerk, vanuit de Verenigde Staten.
landing.pricing_lead: Begin gratis. Upgrade als je meer minuten, langere video’s of geen watermerk nodig hebt.
landing.a_minutes: Op basis van de lengte van elke video die je toevoegt, één keer. Opnieuw clips zoeken, bewerken en exporteren kosten geen extra minuten. Je minuten worden elke maand vernieuwd.
landing.a_free: Ja. Gratis bevat 30 minuten video per maand, video’s tot 20 minuten, export in 720p en een watermerk. Geen creditcard nodig.
landing.a_langs: Video’s worden getranscribeerd in 15 talen, waaronder Nederlands, Engels, Portugees, Spaans, Frans en Duits. Klip herkent de taal, of je kiest hem zelf. De app zelf is in het Engels, Braziliaans-Portugees en Nederlands.
landing.q_training: Trainen jullie AI met mijn video’s?
landing.a_training: Nee. Je content wordt alleen gebruikt om je clips te maken, en onze AI-leveranciers gebruiken hem ook niet voor training.
landing.a_data: In de EU: video’s, transcripten, clips en betalingen. Inloggen verloopt via Clerk in de Verenigde Staten, onder het EU–VS Data Privacy Framework.
landing.a_cancel: Ja. Betaalde abonnementen verlengen maandelijks tot je opzegt via de factuurpagina. Je houdt je abonnement tot het einde van de betaalde maand.
landing.a_rights: Van jou. Je houdt alle rechten op je video’s en op de clips die je maakt.
landing.cta_body: Voeg een video toe en zie wat Klip vindt. Voor het gratis abonnement heb je geen creditcard nodig.
landing.footer_tagline: Korte verticale clips uit lange video’s. Gemaakt door Dexys Works.

pricing.title: Abonnementen
pricing.lead: Minuten tellen één keer per geüploade video. Clips opnieuw bewerken en exporteren is gratis.
pricing.thanks: Bedankt. Je abonnement wordt binnen enkele seconden bijgewerkt.
pricing.tag_free: Probeer het met je eigen video's.
pricing.tag_pro: Voor makers die elke week publiceren.
pricing.tag_business: Voor teams die elke dag publiceren.
